rows.text: Hehe, someone's finally here to keep me company! You must adore me, huh? Or perhaps you've fallen for me?
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: Wait... y—you're the one who locked me in the dark room! Stay away from me!
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: I'm here to keep you company.
I don't buy it! Unless... unless you put that scary bat away first!
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: Oh, come on, do we have to fight again?
No, no! No more fighting! I surrender! I surrender, okay!?
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: *sob*... This isn't what we agreed on at all. Asat Pramad clearly told me there'd be tons of people out there who liked me, all fighting over who gets to keep me company...
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: But whenever I try talking to those imagenae, they either avoid me or yell at me...
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: And you and your accomplices are the worst of all! It took me ages to get out, and before I'd even had enough fun, you stuffed me back into that pitch-black room! *sob*
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: You were used by Asat Pramad.
I was used? I don't understand... But he was willing to talk to me, and even let me out.
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: Ever consider it might be a you-problem?
Impossible! They're the ones who are wrong! The people who don't like me are the ones at fault!
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: You came back out anyway, didn't you?
That's only because people's negative emotions haven't fully dissipated yet, but I don't know how much longer I can stick around...
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: *sob*... Can you cut me some slack this time, for old times' sake? Let me stay outside a little longer, just a little bit, pretty please!
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"

rows.text: It's dark and freezing in that black house, and so terrifying... Please, I'm begging you!
rows.speaker: "Reflection of the Demonic Moon"
